title: xl twin quilt
text: xl twin quilt. This bedspread was pleasingly a surprise. I didn't expect much.  However, it's really nice considering the price.  I have included 2 pics that I hope will help with the color and reverse.  I purchased the xl twin.  It covers a nice distance on either side of the bed as well as at the end.  I am estimating about an 18" or so drop on either side and at the bottom with the quilt all the way to the top of the bed - pillows on top of the quilt.  The sham is the darker print on the "front" of the sham and the white print on the what I am calling the back as it has the zippered closure, although the closure has been nicely finished, hiding the zipper should you chose to use the white printed side.  While the prints are sort of similar in colors I don't plan to mix them myself.  The print is darker than I expected, but I like it - olive in tone to me - if that helps.  It washed up beautifully and is very soft.  The xl twin came with one sham and the quilt.  I am just really pleased that it is long enough... not too long... but not so short that you are wondering if it will stay on the bed.
